"Flagship" is the best product/standard bearer of a organization or a company. It's not something we get to redefine. So, while I do think it's ugly and different apparently for the sake of being different, it IS Nothing's Flagship. It's the best product they have, the standard bearer for their company. Also, you can't compare a fledgling OEM to brands like Samsung & Apple who've been around for decades and have unlimited R&D budgets, can buy SoCs, camera sensors, displays, batteries and the access to emerging tech in enough volume to drive down their cost per unit etc. That said, the landed cost per unit is significantly different so yes you can get "more" phone for the same price but I think it's important to understand what you're comparing.
